statement: Go to the kitchen top and talk to Gabo first; his questline unlocks the World 4 portal and skipping it soft locks you for hours
You should have done a few cooking and breeding quests by the time the portal is unlocked
After the portal unlocks start pushing characters in the demon genie map (name garbled)
Don't level breeding upgrades yet because Oinkin's quest gives rewards upon upgrading
You can unlock all elite classes but only three have abilities; the others unlock in World 5 apart from six talents available to all
Make sure to get all your characters their respective elite classes
Beast Master is Hunter's elite class and specializes in breeding
Talent Curvature of the Law gives higher power level for your pets when breeding
Arena Spirit talent gives extra arena entries and passive pet damage
Breeding gives spices and perks for unlocking pets and completing arena and territory (spice battles); spices are used later in cooking
Use an egg on a species for a chance to unlock a new pet; chance modified by genetic multipliers
Good starting setup to collect spices is the forager genetics then moving to targeters until mid game
Arena at top of screen gives unique bonuses; only two fighters at the start and a third spot unlocks as early as round 2
Good starter arena team is mercenary curse defender (names garbled) which with proper power level gets to about round 15
Round 15 unlocks the fourth pet slot; use mercenary fleeter first then defender
Pre round 50 farm toward rattler monolithic refiller and defender (names garbled)
After that setup you want to get Burger but that is late game
For territory (spice battles) use mercenary fleeter forager then move to rattler monolithic refiller defender
Don't buy eggs with gems unless you are a whale; it is a waste of gems
Blood Berserker is Barbarian's elite class and specializes in cooking
Overflowing Ladle talent increases ladle efficiency and gives more minutes based on level
Apocalypse talent increases cooking efficiency and XP based on 1 million kills per unique mob; same mechanic as other apocalypse
Taste Test talent used on a recipe gives two chances to unlock a new recipe so pushes recipes faster
Cooking gives many World 4 stats and buffs; diamond plates (level 11 or higher on each dish) are a must
Focus plates on eggs corn dogs and cabbage; all give meal cooking speed
Have Blood Berserker cooking 24/7 to boost this tremendously since AFK in the kitchen earns ladles per hour
Only use ladles on the Blood Berserker because of the Overflowing Ladle talent
To unlock meals combine spices from breeding on blocks; a silhouette appears at the bottom if the meal is not unlocked
Higher tier spices mean longer wait time
Bubonic Conjuror is Shaman's elite class and specializes in the lab giving XP and efficiency to others and itself
Lab is a huge World 4 asset giving kills multipliers 3D printer boosts and a lot of money percent
Click the Mainframe at the top and hit upload for your characters; they are unusable while in the lab
Starting lab unprepared is a huge time waster and starves your characters
If you enter World 4 and throw everyone into lab without a 3D printer funding your Refinery you get salt locked hard
There are two connection ranges: player connection from player to player in your Mainframe and node connection (line width) to connect further from nodes
Buy one pile of processor chips per day for three days and consume it to unlock rotational chips for big stat boosts per character
Jewels buy for seven days unlocks lab jewels buffing it by roughly 20 to 30 percent
Only the jewels are truly worth the gems; chips are a waste of gems
Mutated Mush mini boss drops eggs ladles and candy and is found at the purple mushrooms map
Toxic sludge item drops can also be farmed in the World 4 Coliseum at the TV map
Work on FMJ and shakers plus the damage bubbles from the previous video
New bubble egg ink increases egg incubation time so you get eggs faster (as he said)
Mr Massacre big bubble gives more multikill per tier; essential for pushing
Diamond Chef gives faster meal buying and kitchen speed based on your level 11 diamond meal plates
Orange green and purple bubble 14: Severa Purple Prima Green and Multi Orange bubble multipliers stack on previous multipliers
Kill per kill bubble gives extra kills and helps push portals since it doesn't require multikill
World 4 is the quickest world to complete all quests but they are the most important
Quest NPCs: Gabo for world unlock; Nebula Nettie for task unlocks; Oinkin for three stamps; Capital P for other stamps
Don't upgrade breeding until you get the second part of the Oinkin quest
Key stamps: cooked meal stamp (cooking percent) nest egg stamp (breeding XP) and ladle stamp (base cooking efficiency)
Cooked meal nest egg and ladle stamps all come from the Oinkin quest line
Spice stamp gives new recipe speed; egg stamp gives new pet percent chance and can be bought in the World 4 shop
Lab tube stamp gives XP and DNA stamp increases DNA gain from splicing; both come from the Capital P quest line
Probably focus on defense from your stamps because it helps tremendously
Star talent point order: node connection range for lab; egg capacity; mob respawn after Capital P quest; troll gear for late game (as he said)
Then do spice village if you have free star talent points
Crystal mob blast is low-key useless
Gem shop is opinion based so not covered; see his gem shop tier list video
When pushing through World 4 make sure to stop and elitist before you're ready; saves time and headache
Push with void helm void chest void legs void boots caustic scarf tenacity rings and void weapons
You can exchange void weapons for cheese or gear if you don't need defense percent
While pushing run kill per kill big bubble and Mr Massacre bubble
In the lab run killer Brightside for most kills and fastest progression
Don't push unless you have a minimum of 1 million max damage after getting to elitist; not enough to push to the end
Realistic bare minimum is about 20 million damage before World 5
Pre World 5 have full troll gear or at least on bubonic conjuror luster gear with diabolical weapons
Bare minimum gear: diabolical head chest legs and feet with caustic cheese or scarf
Spend Emperor opals per day into the floor shop and party dungeons for a big boost starting World 5
Farm stilt seekers to get troll keys then kill the troll to reach the World 5 waiting room
Before World 5 make sure all meals are at least level 11
Green stack 10 million of each unique item in storage to boost damage from the lab node unadulterated banking fury
Work on gmush kills which increase money percent per million green mushroom spores killed (fungi finger pocketeer); see Ganon's video
Get Bubo one-shotting floms and having 200 crit chance for mega crit
Bubo is your alchemy and money farmer
Keep unlocking all gems for lab
Unlock the cookie chip which gives a 75 percent chance to respawn crystal mob after killing one
Keep working on stamps: circular criticals for free crit chance and jawbreaker for money percent
Level up alchemy bubbles to a minimum of level 80
Grind time to 1K
Level all characters to 200 to 250
Get arena to 200
Max out your post office
